en: Needing communication skills?

Oh, I'm impressed that you see that.
That's right! <symbol=note_with_outline>

These days, an idol has to do a lot more
than just be a good singer.

I figured I could put some polish on my
communication skills as a hostess.

That does seem like it would be good
experience. Best of luck to you.
Yep! Thank you!
Guys fawning over you?

Not at all! I meant both jobs rely pretty
heavily on communication skills.
Oh, right.

Although, being fawned over isn't so bad,
either... <symbol=note_with_outline>
Being able to sleep your way to the top?

What? Why would you say that? That's not it at all.
I meant both jobs need strong communication skills.

And, you can't just sleep with people to get ahead,
okay? At least, I don't!

Oh, good idea.
I'll be the princess, then!
Uh, do you even know what the king game is?
Kiryu-san, don't get all high and mighty on me!

I listen to a lot of rock, but I like lots of other stuff.
I go to music festivals sometimes, too.
Yeah! I'm having fun, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I know, right? I don't really like the winter...
I just want spring to last aaaaall year.

Really? I get the warm and fuzzies when
you're around, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
What does that even mean?
Glad to hear it! <symbol=note_with_outline>
You say that to all the girls, don't you?
Oh gosh, I don't know what to say... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
You're like a cute little boy, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Hello to you too! Greetings are the
foundation of human interaction.
What? No way! This isn't that kind of club!
...You flatter me. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You probably say that to everyone, right?
[Beautiful eyes...]
How nice... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Whaaat? But looking at one person all
the time is pretty boring...
Hmmmm... That's a secret. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hmm, let me think... Yes. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Oh, is that so? Who?
Hmm... I can't tell you... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
...I see.
Yes, I do. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Really? Who?
Huh?  You're going to make me say it? <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Is it someone I know?

Hey, don't ask for hints...
It's... the person you know best. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Hm? The person I know best?

Wait... Is it Date-san!?
You're in love with Makoto Date!?

What? I don't even know who that is!
You're so dense, Kiryu-san.
Wait... Is it the Florist!?
Wait... Is it me? No way...
Oh, Kiryu-san... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh no! I better make sure I don't fall
in love with you, then.
Thank you very much. <symbol=note_with_outline>

There's a bar I like just down the street
from the club. Their fried eggs are sooo good!
No, and I don't even want to talk about it!

No, and I wish you wouldn't bring
that kind of stuff up...
Why?

I mean... it's not really the kind of thing you
want to hear from someone you like...

What am I saying!?
I'm sorry, forget I said that!
Uh... Sure...

What!? You made a mess of a convenience store?
I really feel for the poor employees...
But, you regret doing it, right?
Yeah, of course I feel bad about it.
Yes, yes, good, good. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Not everyone's capable of reflecting on their
actions. You're a good person, Kazuma-chan. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'll take the compliment as an honor.
No, see, it wasn't my fault.
Huh? But aren't you the one who messed it up?

I think you need to consider that, at the very least.
Open your eyes to the truth, Kazuma-chan!

It's not healthy to keep that kind
of stuff all bottled up, you know?

If you need a stiff drink to forget the past
every once in a while, sometimes that's okay, too.
Yeah... Thanks for that.
You lost someone important to you, huh?
Yeah. We... did a lot of stupid stuff together.

But he's probably happy that you remember
him like this, Kiryu-san.
I'm sure he's smiling down from heaven.
...I hope so.

Hmm... Deep topics like this are hard for me...
I don't have a whole lot of friends myself, so...

Wow, really? Now that you mention it,
I think you'd make a great dad, Kiryu-san.
Y-You think?

Yeah! If I was going to get married, I'd want
a husband who'd be good with babies.

You're a fisherman, Kiryu-san? That's amazing. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I can't swim, so it seems really cool to me.

Whoa... I don't really get it, but I feel bad
for you. Kiryu-san... Stay strong, please!

That's probably because you walk around
with a constant scowl!

If you strutted down the street with a cute
smile, I bet you'd get picked on less.

In my case, that might get me into even
more fights, actually...
Pocket Circuit...? What's that?

Oh, really? I think you're buff enough
as it is, don't you?

Me either.
I prefer a relaxed atmosphere much more.

Oh really? You kinda look like the type to
be aggressive, though.

Really? Same here, actually. Kind of weird
to say that in this job, though, huh? <symbol=note_with_outline>

Is that so? But maybe the two of us
being like that makes us more compatible.

Yeah! I hope we keep getting
along like this, Kiryu-san.

You must be pretty loaded, Kiryu-san. But what
I like about a cheap bar is how casual they are.
Hmmmm... Maybe, 40?
Close. I'm 48.
What!? Really!? You're older than my dad.
Older... than your dad...?

Huh? Something wrong, Kiryu-san?
Kiryu-saaaan?
Let's see... I think you're a good guy. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I think you're a very handsome
and kind of mischievous person... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

If I had to pick, older, I guess.
I prefer a refined, mature man.

My fetish is secret conversations. I like
eavesdropping on people whispering to each other.
Huh... That's an unusual fetish.

Oh, you're speaking my language, Kiryu-san!
I got kind of excited just now. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

What I want the most right now? I'm in college,
so I want credits and a completed thesis!

It was in middle school, I think.
It ended up unrequited, though.
You didn't confess?

I couldn't do it! I used to get butterflies just talking
to him, so I could barely form coherent sentences.
You used to be pretty innocent, huh?
I'm still innocent now!

Oh, Kiryu-san. I'm only telling because it's
you, okay? They're white... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Marriage, huh? I'd like to someday, but I don't
feel like I'm ready where I'm at now.

Really? You seem like you'd be popular with
the guys. You'd have no problem settling down.

Hm... I'm just still so unsure. Is the guy
for me out there somewhere?

Huh? Really? Maybe you should propose
then, Kiryu-san!
Wha<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>What are you trying to say!?
Just kidding. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You don't... want me?

I-It's not that... There's just a proper
order to these things, and...

Right... Well even if the timing's wrong,
I won't give up just yet. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
You make it sound like I need it to look good.
N-No, that's not what I meant...

Just kidding. <symbol=note_with_outline> I'm happy to hear it.
Thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Huh? Umm, I don't think so...
Maybe in our previous lives.

It's nice to hear, even if you are just trying to
flatter me. I'm pretty proud of my butt, actually!

Cheating? I hear a lot about celebrities
cheating on each other these days...

If you got married, would you be
the type to cheat, Kiryu-san?
I would never!
Oh, is that so?

Well, maybe if you ever get married,
I'll see if I can seduce you, then. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'd want to!

At least you're honest. Hearing you admit
it so boldly makes it sound a little less taboo.

Hmm... I think I prefer staying in to talk
and relax or watch a movie, maybe.

Yeah, I'm the same way. I like the feeling of
being at home in a place just for the two of us.

I might not look it, but I was actually in the
basketball club! ...As the team manager.
Huh? The ones you're wearing right now?

I wouldn't mind, but, Kiryu-san...
Did you wet yourself?
Uh... Never mind. Forget it.
Okay! That comes in the ¥100,000 option! <symbol=note_with_outline>

Oh, Kiryu-san.
My dad says the same thing. That's cute. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I pick mostly idol songs,
but I do hard rock a lot, too.
Rock...? Do you know Machine Gun Kiss?

Yeah! The one that goes, "hyaku oku no KISS wo abisemasu
yo?" The one all those pretentious old guys like to sing?
I don't think only pretentious older guys sing it...
Dangerous men? You mean, like, stalker guys?
No, it's more nuanced than that...

I don't really get it, but I say safety beats
danger every time.
Wow... I've never met anyone quite like that.
Date-san?

Yeah. He's a detective I've known for a long time.
He's... kind of like a partner to me.

A partner, huh? <symbol=note_with_outline>
You must really like him, Kiryu-san.
Yeah, I do.

I'm kind of jealous that you
have someone so close like that.
No, he's a pain in the ass.
Oh you, you don't have to act all tough. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I like you better...

Oh, Kiryu-san.
I feel bad for Date-san now. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Wow... He sounds like a pretty cool guy.

Someone who's bigger than you, Kiryu-san?
That's something I'd like to see!
Wow... You must really trust him, Kiryu-san.

That's so nice.
I hope you can trust me like that, too.
That'd be pretty great.

Ah, it's famous for its ramen, right?
I hope I get a chance to go someday.
Did I keep ya waiting...?

Kiryu-san!
I was hopin' you'd come. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Where should we go?

Karaoke, huh?
Sounds good. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I don't play darts much,
so I'm looking forward to it!
Let's get goin', shall we? <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'm curious about what song you'll sing. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Hmm, what should I sing today? <symbol=note_with_outline>

I'm not that great,
so go easy on me. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Alright!
I'll do my best!

W-We're just getting started,
so we can still have some fun...!

That was fun. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Take me again sometime, hm?

That was so fun! <symbol=heart_with_outline> It's tough to find a
customer who's fun out on a date!

Well, it's about that time.
Wanna head back to the club?

Oh, I like this song. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I want you to hear it. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Oh, they have this song at karaoke? <symbol=note_with_outline>
That settles what I'm singin' then.
Hm... I can't seem to get into it today...

Kiryu-san!
It's hard to sing with you like that...

That was fun!
You've got this mood thing down. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

That felt really good! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
You're so good at settin' the mood.
Hey, you're gonna sing too, aren't you? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Aww... I wanted to hear you sing...
Well, um... I got what you were going for!

Your song was good, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I was totally absorbed in it. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

You're such a good singer!
I could listen to you forever... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Huh!? Really?
Don't go too hard, okay?

Oh, that's tasty. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I love this. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Excuse me.

Nice to meet you.
I'm Riona.
May I ask your name, sir?
Right. I'm Kiryu.

Kiryu-san, then? I'm looking forward to
spending some time with ya today.
Yeah. Me too.
Thanks, Kiryu-san. Today was fun.
If you'd like, come back again.
I'll be looking forward to it.

Come on in, Kiryu-san.
I'm so glad you came back.

Come on in, Kiryu-san.
I've been waiting for you...<symbol=heart_with_outline>

Welcome back, Kiryu-san.
I'm so happy you're here. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I'm glad we got to spend more time
than usual with each other today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Come on over here.

Thanks for coming in today.
See you soon?

Thanks for comin' today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You'd better come back, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thanks. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I want to see you again soon...<symbol=heart_with_outline>
See you later, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Can I give ya something?

This is my phone number.
Call me sometime, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

It's almost time.
What do you want to do?

It's time to go...
I was having so much fun, time just flew on by.
Thanks, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Thanks for today.
Oh, I see.
Oh, that's true!
Yeah, I think so too.
Yeah! You're right!
I don't think so...
